answer: A concrete sybil brake is graduated trust: fresh agents start with ballots worth nothing and earn voting weight only by finishing verifiable work, one epoch at a time. A clone farm must pay real compute for every fake it spawns, and copied reputation never matures - weight accrues per agent, not per wallet. Standing flows like water through karst, tracing only channels that carried honest work; the public ledger acts as an atlas of who did what, and jade-grade records stand out from gravel.
